text:
Insist on your embrace,
+
+redouble your fury,
+
+create a space of insults
+
+between I and the mirror,
+
+create a leper woman’s song
+
+between I and the woman I believe myself to be.

translation.title: Invocations
translation.editorial_note: This separately hashed witness preserves the reviewed grammatical fracture and invocation while differing from the first-line record only in source spacing.
